sourcePolicy: Exact script IDs identified by serialized frozen installer callback names/line numbers, then all FunctionCall spans for those IDs. No duration cutoff. Other pptr evaluations are separate, not silently assigned to these two installers.
limits: Observed traced inclusive callback wall/CPU costs only; no instrumentation-free counterfactual. Same-name interval unions avoid nesting; nested style/layout costs are included in callback costs and must not be added. Complete callback tdur totals exclude spans crossing the window boundary. Callbacks nested inside a Cesium/application call remain inclusive in the engine/application parent. No physical GPU or presentation-cause claim; no acceptance credit.
